Write the complex number $z$, shown on the Argand diagram above, in exponential form.
feedback.worked_solution:
The complex number shown in the Argand diagram can be written as

$$
\begin{aligned}z & =x+\text{i}y \\  & =2+2\text{i}.\end{aligned}
$$

To write it in the form $z=r{\text{e}}^{\text{i}\theta },$ where $r=|z|$ and $\theta =\operatorname{arg}⁡(z),$ we first calculate $r:$

$$
\begin{aligned}r=|z| & =\sqrt{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{{2}^{2}+{2}^{2}} \\  & =2\sqrt{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, since $z$ lies in the first quadrant, we can find the angle $\theta $ as

$$
\begin{aligned}\theta =\operatorname{arg}⁡(z) & =\operatorname{arctan}⁡(\frac{y}{x}) \\  & =\operatorname{arctan}⁡(1) \\  & =\frac{\pi }{4}.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, substituting $r=2\sqrt{2}$ and $\theta =\frac{\pi }{4}$ into $z=r{e}^{\text{i}\theta },$ we get 

$$
z=2\sqrt{2}\,{\text{e}}^{\pi \text{i}/4}.
$$
